name: SD-WAN and SASE Networking
certifications: Cisco 300-415 ENSDWI: Implementing Cisco SD-WAN Solutions
Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist (FCSS) SD-WAN Architect
tools: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN (Manager, Controller, Validator, WAN Edge)

beginner.summary: For network engineers who are starting with SD-WAN. Covers why WANs changed, a lab with Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN and FortiGate, WAN transports, orchestration, control and data planes, overlay tunnels, zero-touch provisioning, Cisco components and configuration groups, Fortinet SD-WAN zones, rules and performance SLAs, application-aware routing, SLA probes, QoS, local internet breakout, segmentation and security, routing integration, cloud on-ramps, monitoring, branch high availability and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Understands IP routing, subnets and VLANs
Has configured a router or firewall
outcomes: Explain SD-WAN architecture, overlays and onboarding
Configure Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN and Fortinet SD-WAN for branches
Steer applications by measured path quality with QoS and local breakout
Secure, monitor, make resilient and troubleshoot branch WANs

days.topic: SD-WAN Overview: Why Enterprise WANs Changed
subtopics: Certifications: Cisco ENSDWI and Fortinet SD-WAN
Course project overview: a head office, three branches and two clouds
days.lab_task: Map the course company's current WAN, list its applications and their needs, and show where SD-WAN would change traffic paths and costs.
days.deliverable: Current WAN map with SD-WAN opportunities
checks: Sites, links and applications are on the map
Application needs for latency and loss are listed
Overlay, underlay and orchestration are explained correctly

days.topic: Lab Setup: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Sandbox and FortiGate VMs
subtopics: Booking a Cisco DevNet SD-WAN sandbox
FortiGate virtual machines for the lab
days.lab_task: Reserve the Cisco sandbox, deploy two FortiGate VMs with two transports, add a network emulator to impair one link and confirm traffic flows end to end.
checks: SD-WAN Manager and both FortiGates are reachable
The emulator adds loss and delay to one link

days.topic: WAN Transports: MPLS, Broadband, LTE, 5G and Satellite
subtopics: Choosing a transport mix per site
days.lab_task: Choose a transport mix for each course site based on application needs, cost and diversity, and justify it.
checks: Each site has a transport mix
No site depends on a single path

days.topic: SD-WAN Architecture: Orchestration, Control and Data Planes
subtopics: Controllers on premises or in the cloud
days.lab_task: Draw the planes for Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN and Fortinet SD-WAN, find each component in the lab and show what happens when a controller is unreachable.
days.deliverable: Architecture comparison with a failure test
checks: Each plane's components are named for both vendors
Components are located in the lab
Data traffic continues when a controller is unreachable

days.topic: Overlay Tunnels: IPsec Fabrics, Hub-and-Spoke and Full Mesh
days.lab_task: Build a hub-and-spoke overlay, add on-demand tunnels between branches and measure tunnel counts as sites are added.
checks: Spokes reach each other through the hub
Tunnel counts are recorded per topology

days.topic: Device Onboarding: Zero-Touch Provisioning and Certificates
days.lab_task: Onboard a new WAN edge with zero-touch provisioning, fix a seeded certificate problem and replace a failed device with the same configuration.
checks: The new edge joins the fabric without local setup
The replacement device takes over the site

days.topic: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Components: Manager, Controller, Validator and WAN Edges
days.lab_task: Inspect control connections, TLOCs and OMP routes in the Cisco fabric, change a transport colour and confirm the effect on tunnels.
checks: Control connections and TLOCs are listed
OMP routes show the expected next hops
The colour change alters tunnel formation

days.topic: Configuration Groups and Templates in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN
days.lab_task: Build a configuration group for small branches with variables, deploy it to two edges, change one setting and roll back a bad change.
days.deliverable: Branch configuration group with deployment record
checks: The group covers system, transport and service settings

days.topic: Fortinet Secure SD-WAN: Members, Zones, Performance SLAs and Rules
days.lab_task: Configure SD-WAN members and zones on a FortiGate, add performance SLAs, write rules that prefer the best link for SaaS and send bulk traffic to broadband.
checks: SaaS and bulk traffic take their chosen links

days.topic: Application-Aware Routing and Path Selection
subtopics: Fallback when no path meets the SLA
days.lab_task: Send voice over the best-quality path, move it when the emulator adds loss, load-share bulk traffic and confirm fallback when every path breaks the SLA.
checks: Traffic uses the fallback when no path meets the SLA

days.topic: Performance SLAs: Probes, Latency, Jitter and Loss Thresholds
days.lab_task: Tune probe intervals and thresholds so voice moves within a few seconds of loss without flapping, and record the trade-offs.
checks: Path problems are detected within the target time
Paths do not flap under small changes

days.topic: Quality of Service for Voice and Video over SD-WAN
subtopics: Why QoS still matters with SD-WAN
Queuing and shaping on WAN links
days.lab_task: Mark and queue voice, video and bulk traffic, shape the broadband link and show that voice quality holds during a bulk transfer.
days.deliverable: QoS policy with call quality results

days.topic: Direct Internet Access and Local Breakout
subtopics: Breakout to a cloud security service
days.lab_task: Break out SaaS traffic locally at one branch with security on, keep other traffic backhauled and compare SaaS response times.
checks: SaaS traffic leaves at the branch

days.topic: SD-WAN Security: Segmentation, Firewalling and Encryption
subtopics: Segments for users, guests and devices
days.lab_task: Separate corporate, guest and IoT segments, add branch firewalling and intrusion prevention, and prove guests cannot reach corporate systems.
checks: Branch firewall and IPS act on traffic

days.topic: Routing Integration: BGP and OSPF at the Branch and Data Centre
days.lab_task: Run OSPF with a branch LAN router and BGP with the data centre core, redistribute routes into the overlay and prevent a seeded routing loop.
checks: OSPF and BGP sessions are up
Branch and data centre routes reach each other

days.topic: Cloud On-Ramps: SaaS Optimisation and Cloud Hubs
subtopics: Virtual WAN edges in the cloud
days.lab_task: Deploy a virtual WAN edge in a cloud region, route branch traffic to cloud workloads through it and steer a SaaS application to its best exit.
checks: The cloud edge joins the fabric
Branches reach cloud workloads through the hub
The SaaS app uses its best exit

days.topic: Monitoring SD-WAN: Dashboards, Flow Visibility and Alarms
days.lab_task: Build a monitoring view for the course fabric, trigger a link failure and an SLA breach, and find both in alarms and flow data.
checks: Dashboards show site, link and application health
The link failure raises an alarm
The SLA breach is visible in flow data

days.topic: Branch High Availability: Dual Edges, Dual Transports and Failover
days.lab_task: Build a dual-edge branch with two transports, fail one transport and then one edge, and measure how long traffic stops each time.
days.deliverable: Highly available branch with failover times
checks: Both edges and transports are active
Traffic survives transport and edge failures

days.topic: Troubleshooting SD-WAN: Control Connections, Tunnels and Path Choices
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, a control connection failure, a tunnel down, a wrong path choice and an unrecognised application, fix them and record the steps.
checks: Traffic flows correctly after each fix

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: SD-WAN Rollout for Three Branches
days.lab_task: Roll out SD-WAN to three branches with a transport plan, zero-touch onboarding, application routing, QoS, local breakout, segmentation, monitoring and failover tests.
days.deliverable: Working three-branch rollout with a demo
checks: Applications follow policy under impaired links

intermediate.summary: For network engineers who design and run SD-WAN for many sites. Covers design methodology, segmentation at scale, centralised control and data policies, application recognition, FEC and packet duplication, multi-region fabrics, data centre integration, cloud networking with AWS Cloud WAN, Azure Virtual WAN and Google Network Connectivity Center, SASE integration, ZTNA and secure web gateways, Fortinet at scale, other platforms compared, automation, telemetry and experience monitoring, AI operations, MPLS migration, wireless WAN, collaboration tuning and certification preparation.
prerequisites: Has configured SD-WAN branches with application policy
outcomes: Design SD-WAN for many site types with segmentation and central policy
Integrate data centres, clouds and SASE services
Automate, monitor and tune SD-WAN at scale
Migrate from MPLS and prepare for ENSDWI and Fortinet SD-WAN exams

days.topic: SD-WAN Design Methodology: Requirements, Site Types and Topologies
days.lab_task: Gather requirements for fifty sites, define four site types, choose topologies and write a design document for review.
checks: Requirements cover applications, security and capacity
Every site maps to a site type

days.topic: Segmentation at Scale: VPNs, VRFs and Service Chaining
days.lab_task: Build corporate, PCI and partner segments across all sites, leak one shared service route safely and chain PCI traffic through a firewall.
checks: Segments cannot reach each other except as allowed
The shared service is reachable from both segments
PCI traffic passes through the firewall

days.topic: Centralised Policy: Control Policies, Data Policies and Topology Shaping
days.lab_task: Use a control policy to build regional hub-and-spoke, add a data policy that sends guest traffic to local breakout and preview both before activation.

days.topic: Application Recognition and Custom Applications
subtopics: Custom applications by address, port or name
days.lab_task: Define custom applications for two internal apps, fix a misclassified SaaS app and report bandwidth by application group.
checks: The SaaS app is classified correctly
Bandwidth by application group is reported

days.topic: Forward Error Correction, Packet Duplication and TCP Optimisation
days.lab_task: Add loss to a link, protect voice with FEC and packet duplication, measure quality and overhead, and choose a setting.
days.deliverable: Loss mitigation tests and a recommendation

days.topic: Multi-Region Fabric and Hierarchical Designs
days.lab_task: Split the fabric into two access regions and a core region with border routers, and confirm inter-region traffic uses the core.
checks: Tunnel counts fall compared with full mesh

days.topic: Data Centre Integration: Hubs, Redundancy and Routing Policies
days.lab_task: Connect two data centres as hubs, prefer one per region, fail it and show branches moving to the other with routing intact.
days.deliverable: Dual data centre design with failover test
checks: Regions use their preferred data centre
Branches move to the other data centre
Traffic still passes the data centre firewalls

days.topic: Cloud Networking with SD-WAN: AWS Cloud WAN, Azure Virtual WAN and Google NCC
subtopics: SD-WAN integration with AWS Cloud WAN and Transit Gateway
days.lab_task: Connect the fabric to one cloud networking service with BGP, carry two segments into the cloud and estimate monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Cloud integration with segments and cost
checks: BGP sessions with the cloud are up
Both segments reach their cloud networks only

days.topic: SASE Integration: Security Service Edge for SD-WAN Branches
days.lab_task: Send branch internet traffic to an SSE service through tunnels, apply web and threat policy there, fail one SSE location and confirm recovery.
checks: SSE policy acts on branch traffic
Traffic moves to the second SSE location

days.topic: ZTNA and Secure Web Gateway for Branch Users
days.lab_task: Publish a private application through ZTNA for branch users, apply secure web gateway policy and check that only compliant devices reach the app.
days.deliverable: ZTNA and SWG setup for branches
checks: The private app is reachable through ZTNA
Web policy acts on branch users

days.topic: Fortinet SD-WAN at Scale with FortiManager and Overlay Templates
days.lab_task: Build a fifty-site Fortinet design with overlay templates, deploy it to lab devices, enable ADVPN and monitor it in FortiAnalyzer.

days.topic: Other Platforms Compared: Prisma SD-WAN, Arista VeloCloud, HPE Aruba EdgeConnect, Versa and Cato
subtopics: Lab trials of a second platform
days.lab_task: Trial one more platform in a lab, configure the same branch policy as before and score three platforms against the course company's criteria.
checks: The same policy runs on the trial platform
Platforms are scored on agreed criteria

days.topic: Automation: APIs, Terraform and Ansible for SD-WAN
days.lab_task: Onboard a new site from a data file with Terraform or Ansible, make a bulk policy change through the API and test the automation before running it.
checks: The new site is created from data
The bulk change applies to all target sites
Tests catch a bad input before it runs

days.topic: Monitoring at Scale: Telemetry, NetFlow and Digital Experience Monitoring
days.lab_task: Stream telemetry and flows to a monitoring platform, baseline link use, add experience monitoring for two SaaS apps and alert on degradation.

days.topic: AI Operations for SD-WAN: Anomaly Detection and Predictive Path Selection
days.lab_task: Use AI operations features on lab data, compare an anomaly finding with the real cause and test whether predictive path selection moves traffic earlier.
checks: The anomaly finding is compared with the real cause
Predictive selection moves traffic before the breach
Trust levels for AI features are recorded

days.topic: Migration from MPLS to SD-WAN: Coexistence and Cutover
days.lab_task: Migrate two lab sites from MPLS to SD-WAN while a third stays on MPLS, keep routing correct during coexistence and roll back one cutover.
checks: Migrated and MPLS sites reach each other
Sites cut over with minimal outage

days.topic: Wireless WAN: 5G, LTE and Satellite Links in SD-WAN
days.lab_task: Add a cellular link as backup with a data cap policy, keep bulk traffic off it and design a pop-up site that runs only on 5G and satellite.
days.deliverable: Wireless WAN policies and pop-up design
checks: Bulk traffic stays off the metered link
The pop-up site design meets its needs

days.topic: Voice, Video and Collaboration Performance Tuning
days.lab_task: Tune breakout, SLAs and QoS for a collaboration service, run test calls under impairment and use call quality reports to confirm the fix.
checks: Settings are changed for collaboration traffic
Test calls stay within quality targets
A poor call problem is diagnosed and fixed

days.topic: Cisco ENSDWI 300-415 and Fortinet SD-WAN Certification Preparation
subtopics: Mapping course days to exam topics
days.lab_task: Take timed practice sets for ENSDWI and the Fortinet SD-WAN exam, map every miss to a course day and repeat the weakest lab tasks.
checks: Each miss is mapped to a course day
The weakest lab tasks are repeated

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Regional SD-WAN with Cloud and SASE Integration
subtopics: Data centre, cloud and SASE integration
days.lab_task: Deliver a regional SD-WAN for fifty sites in the lab with site types, segmentation, central policy, dual data centres, a cloud connection, SSE for internet traffic, automated onboarding and monitoring.
checks: Sites follow their types and policies
Data centres, cloud and SSE work together

advanced.summary: For network architects and WAN programme leads. Covers WAN strategy with SD-WAN, SASE and network as a service, global architecture, policy design at scale, multi-cloud networking, single-vendor and multi-vendor SASE, Zero Trust branches, industry site designs, managed SD-WAN, performance engineering, resilience engineering, automation pipelines with a source of truth, assurance and reporting, security assurance, vendor selection, large migration programmes, cost engineering, the operations model, self-driving WANs and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Has designed or run SD-WAN for many sites
Understands cloud networking and security services
Responsible for WAN strategy, architecture or operations
outcomes: Set WAN and SASE strategy and global architecture
Design multi-cloud, Zero Trust and industry-specific WANs
Run automation, assurance, migration and cost programmes
Lead WAN operations and vendor decisions

days.topic: Enterprise WAN Strategy: SD-WAN, SASE and Network as a Service
subtopics: SD-WAN, SASE and network as a service models
days.lab_task: Write a three-year WAN strategy for the course company with a delivery model, phases, business case and outcome measures, and present it to the CIO persona.
checks: The CIO persona approves the strategy

days.topic: Global SD-WAN Architecture: Regions, Hubs and Failure Domains
days.lab_task: Design a global SD-WAN for four hundred sites in four regions with controller placement and failure domains, and defend it in a review.
checks: Regions, hubs and controllers are placed
The review accepts the design with actions

days.topic: Large-Scale Policy Design and Change Control
days.lab_task: Design a policy hierarchy for four regions, roll out a risky policy change in stages with tests and roll back one stage.
days.deliverable: Policy hierarchy and staged change record
checks: Shared and regional policies are separated
The change rolls out region by region

days.topic: Multi-Cloud Networking Architecture with SD-WAN
subtopics: Cloud-native networking compared with SD-WAN overlays
days.lab_task: Design networking for workloads in two clouds and the data centre, compare SD-WAN overlays with cloud-native options and cost cross-cloud traffic.
checks: Workloads in every location are connected with segments
Overlay and cloud-native options are compared

days.topic: Single-Vendor SASE and Multi-Vendor Designs
days.lab_task: Compare a single-vendor SASE design with a multi-vendor design for the course company on policy, operations, cost and risk, and recommend one.
checks: Both models are compared on four criteria
The recommendation includes an exit plan

days.topic: Zero Trust Branch Design
days.lab_task: Design a Zero Trust branch with identity-based access, IoT profiling and microsegmentation, and test that a compromised device cannot move laterally.
days.deliverable: Zero Trust branch design with tests
checks: Access depends on identity and device
IoT devices are identified and segmented
Lateral movement from the test device fails

days.topic: SD-WAN for Retail, Manufacturing and Healthcare Sites
subtopics: Retail sites: payment, guest and stores at scale
Manufacturing sites: OT networks and uptime
Healthcare sites: clinical systems and privacy
days.lab_task: Design site templates for a store, a factory and a clinic with their compliance and uptime needs, and test local survivability for the factory.
checks: Each template meets its industry needs
The factory keeps running when the WAN fails

days.topic: Service Provider and Managed SD-WAN Models
days.lab_task: Compare managed, co-managed and self-run models for the course company, draft key service levels and plan a transition between providers.
days.deliverable: Service model comparison and transition plan
checks: The models are compared on control, cost and risk
Service levels cover availability and change times

days.topic: Performance Engineering: Capacity, Encryption Overhead and Scaling Limits
days.lab_task: Size hubs and edges for the global design, load-test an edge with encryption and inspection, find the bottleneck and write a capacity report.
checks: Headroom is stated for each tier

days.topic: Resilience Engineering: Controller Outages, Transport Failures and Disaster Recovery
days.lab_task: Test controller loss, a regional transport outage and a hub failure in the lab, measure impact and update the runbooks.

days.topic: Network Automation Pipelines for SD-WAN: Source of Truth and CI Validation
subtopics: A source of truth for sites and policies
Rollback from the source of truth
tools: NetBox or another source of truth
days.lab_task: Drive site configuration from a source of truth through a pipeline with validation and post-change checks, detect drift and roll back a bad change.
checks: Site changes come from the source of truth
Bad data is caught before deployment
A bad change is rolled back
objectives: Automate with a source of truth

days.topic: Observability and Assurance: SLAs, Experience Scores and Reporting
days.lab_task: Define experience scores and SLAs for five key apps, report carrier performance and present a monthly assurance report to the business.
checks: The business report shows trends and actions

days.topic: Security Assurance: Encryption, Key Management and Compliance
days.lab_task: Check overlay encryption and key rotation against policy, renew certificates before expiry and prepare audit evidence for the WAN.

days.topic: Vendor Selection and Proof of Concept for SD-WAN and SASE
days.lab_task: Write an RFP and a proof of concept plan with test cases, score two seeded vendor responses and record the decision.
days.deliverable: RFP, proof of concept plan and decision
checks: The RFP covers technical and commercial needs
The decision is recorded with scores

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration Programmes: Waves, Site Surveys and Cutover
days.lab_task: Plan a four-hundred-site migration in waves with surveys, logistics and cutover checklists, and run a rehearsal for the first wave.
days.deliverable: Migration programme plan and rehearsal report
checks: Waves cover all sites with dependencies
Programme reporting tracks progress and risks

days.topic: Cost Engineering: Transport Mix, Licences and Total Cost of Ownership
days.lab_task: Build a total cost of ownership model for the global WAN, optimise the transport mix and licence tiers and track savings against the business case.
checks: Changes reduce cost without breaking SLAs
Savings are tracked against the business case

days.topic: SD-WAN Operations Model: NOC Processes, Change and Vendor Management
days.lab_task: Design the WAN operations model with NOC roles, incident and change processes and carrier management, and report a seeded month of service metrics.
checks: Incidents and changes follow the processes

days.topic: Self-Driving WANs: AI and Automation for Closed-Loop Operations
days.lab_task: Build a closed-loop action that moves traffic off a degrading link and opens a carrier ticket, with guardrails and approval for wider changes, and evaluate it on replayed events.
checks: The action moves traffic and opens a ticket
Results on replayed events are scored

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Overlay, Underlay and Application Problems
subtopics: Application problems that look like network problems
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded problems across many sites, a carrier fault, a control plane limit and an application issue, coordinate fixes and write an incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, fixes and an incident review
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
Carriers and vendors get clear evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Global WAN Transformation Design
days.lab_task: Present a global WAN transformation to a review board with the strategy, global architecture, SASE and Zero Trust design, migration programme, automation pipeline, assurance plan, cost model and operations model.
days.deliverable: Transformation design with evidence and a board decision
checks: Architecture and SASE design pass review
Migration and cost plans are realistic
Automation and operations plans have owners
